ModMetaData.name: Better Attack Orders for Simple Sidearms
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes a Simple Sidearms deadlock: a pawn carrying a longer-ranged sidearm could not even be ORDERED to attack a distant target — the fire order was computed against the equipped weapon only ("Out of range"), and Simple Sidearms' auto-switch never got a chance to run because no attack job could form.
With this mod, the fire order considers every weapon the pawn carries. If only a carried sidearm can reach the target, ordering the attack swaps to it (using Simple Sidearms' own weapon selection) and fires. No new buttons, no settings — the existing order just works.
Requires Harmony and Simple Sidearms. No Combat Extended dependency (works fine with or without it).
